depiction.primary_object: plain black arrow pointing straight up

readings.meaning: upload, push, or send to server
high priority or top of list

ambiguity: Completely generic directional UI arrow; easily confused with high-priority task status markers, sort-ascending buttons, or shift-key indicators rather than a task subject.

example_tasks.task: Upload wedding raw photos to shared family drive
Upgrade home fiber internet plan to 1 Gbps
Increase monthly auto-transfer to emergency savings by $150
Push staging database migrations before the afternoon release
Raise standing desk presets by two centimeters
Upload signed lease renewal PDF to the tenant portal before Friday at noon
Upgrade Postgres cluster from version 14 to 16 during the Sunday maintenance window

context_tasks.task: Carry winter storage bins up to the attic

near_misses.task: Set up new living room bookshelf
Follow up with Sarah about the catering quote
Pick up dry cleaning on the way home
High-priority dentist appointment for broken molar
Update resume with latest project metrics

reasoning: A bare upward arrow is generic interface chrome and looks like a priority indicator or sort control in a task list rather than a concrete subject. Even for actions like uploading, upgrading, or increasing, more specific icons (cloud upload, trending chart, package arrow) communicate the task far better.
